narratorText: Officer Jack Rowan at full speed.
Marco Velez tips the stolen Ferrari.
Screeching metal, gripping turns, barriers fall.
Rain-slick roads race through Brick City.
Sirens wail, the chase tightens.
Officer Jack Rowan jerks unit 27 from the substation as Marco Velez snaps the stolen red Ferrari across tram grooves and into Downtown Brick City traffic.
Marco steals half a lane from a delivery van and cuts past a coffee shop corner.
Jack forces the cruiser through the same gap a breath later, missing a newspaper box by one stud.
Rain needles the avenue as Marco turns for the Riverside Overpass.
Jack could lock the side street with one hard stop, but he keeps the nose pointed at the Ferrari, and the safer block falls away behind him.
The road climbs above the river, slick and narrow under flashing lamps. Jack dives inside the curve to pinch Marco at the rail.
His front fender screams along concrete, sparks spit through spray, and unit 27 drops three car lengths while the Ferrari takes the wider arc clean.
Warehouses and container stacks rise as daylight thins at the harbor. Jack aims for the loading bays until Lieutenant Elena Cross cuts in over the radio.
She sends him to the vehicle exit and tells him Marco is driving straight for the dock gate.
Jack sees the yellow-and-black barrier arm over wet concrete and knows the cruiser will not catch the Ferrari in a straight run.
He wrenches right, floors unit 27 at the gray post, and slams the bumper into the barrier base hard enough to shear the hinge.
The striped arm whips down across the only clean lane just as Marco commits.
The Ferrari hits the dropped gate, spins on the pavement, and stops with steam lifting from the crumpled hood.
Sirens stack across the dockyard as Jack shoves his bent door open and reaches the wreck first.
Marco kicks through the shattered side window and runs for the warehouse bays. Cross cuts a command car across the forklift lane and orders lockdown.
Steel shutters rattle down while cruisers swing headlights over the stacks. Marco breaks for the fence line instead.
Jack closes beside a row of oil drums, grabs his shoulder, and drives him face-first onto the wet concrete.
The cuffs click shut under police lights. The Ferrari stays at the shattered gate, and Marco's road out of Brick City ends under the barrier Jack dropped.
